steps.en: Install it globally, generate its root CA and trust that CA on the device
steps.zh: 全局安装，生成根证书并在设备上信任它

steps.en: Write a rule module whose hooks rewrite requests or return a mock response
steps.zh: 写一个规则模块，在钩子里改请求或直接回假响应

steps.en: Start it with the rule (add --intercept to decrypt HTTPS), then point the client's proxy at :8001
steps.zh: 带规则启动（解 HTTPS 加 --intercept），代理设为 :8001

steps.en: Decrypts intercepted HTTPS with per-host certs signed by its CA and calls your hooks
steps.zh: 用自家 CA 签的证书解开被拦截的 HTTPS，并调用你的钩子

steps.en: Forwards the possibly rewritten request, or answers directly if a hook returned a response
steps.zh: 转发改过的请求，或在钩子给了响应时直接回给客户端

steps.en: Lists every request and response in its web UI on port 8002
steps.zh: 在 8002 端口的网页里列出每一条请求和响应

value.en: You see and rewrite an app's real traffic with a few lines of JavaScript, without touching the app or the server
value.zh: 不改 App 也不改服务端，几行 JavaScript 就能看清并改写真实流量

sources: https://github.com/alibaba/anyproxy/blob/master/docs-src/en/src_doc.md (npm install -g anyproxy; proxy on 127.0.0.1:8001; web UI http://127.0.0.1:8002; anyproxy-ca; anyproxy --intercept; anyproxy --rule ./rule.js; *beforeSendRequest(requestDetail); returning a response skips the target server)
